body:
## Problem

`docker build .` fails on `main` (`fa90d37`, v0.28.0). Since "runs as a single Docker container" is the project's headline deployment story, the release cannot currently be deployed that way.

```
#13 0.606 error: #[derive(RustEmbed)] folder '/app/ui/dist' does not exist. cwd: '/app'
#13 0.606   --> src/admin_ui.rs:17:1
#13 0.606 17 | / /// The built admin UI bundle, embedded at compile time.
#13 0.606 18 | | #[derive(RustEmbed)]
#13 0.606 19 | | #[folder = "ui/dist"]
#13 0.606 20 | | struct Assets;

#13 1.037 error[E0599]: no associated function or constant named `get` found for struct `Assets`
#13 1.037   --> src/admin_ui.rs:43:24

#13 1.684 error: could not compile `link-assistant-router` (lib) due to 2 previous errors
ERROR: failed to solve: process "/bin/sh -c touch src/lib.rs src/main.rs && cargo build --release"
       did not complete successfully: exit code: 101
```

The second error is a knock-on: `RustEmbed` cannot expand without the folder, so `Assets::get` never exists.

## Cause

`ui/dist` is deliberately committed — `.gitignore` says so explicitly:

```
# Admin UI toolchain: `ui/dist` IS committed (it is embedded in the binary),
```

and it is present in a fresh clone:

```
$ git ls-files ui/dist
ui/dist/assets/app.js
ui/dist/index.html
```

But the Dockerfile never copies it into the build context. The builder stage copies only:

```dockerfile
WORKDIR /app
COPY Cargo.toml Cargo.lock ./
COPY src/ src/
```

So `/app/ui/dist` does not exist inside the image, while it does exist on a developer's checkout — which is why `cargo build` locally succeeds and the Docker build does not.

## Fix

One line, before `COPY src/ src/`:

```dockerfile
COPY ui/dist/ ui/dist/
COPY src/ src/
```

Verified: with that line added and nothing else changed, the image builds and runs.

```
$ docker build -t router-fixtest .
...
naming to docker.io/library/router-fixtest:latest done
$ docker images router-fixtest
router-fixtest:latest   164MB
```

The resulting container behaves as intended — admin endpoints closed by default:

```
POST /api/tokens      HTTP=401
GET  /api/tokens/list HTTP=401
/v1/usage             HTTP=401
INFO Generated a bootstrap admin token; admin endpoints are closed
INFO Admin UI disabled (set --admin-port / ADMIN_PORT to enable)
```

Placing the copy before `COPY src/ src/` keeps the layer cache useful: UI assets change less often than Rust sources.

## Why CI did not catch it

`.github/workflows/release.yml` runs `docker/build-push-action` — but only in the release job, i.e. *after* a version has been tagged and cut. Nothing builds the image on a pull request, so a Dockerfile that cannot build merges cleanly and only fails once it is already released.

Worth adding a `docker build` (no push) step to the PR checks. It is the one artifact users are told to deploy, and it is currently the only part of the build not exercised before release.
title: Docker build is broken on main: Dockerfile never copies the committed ui/dist that RustEmbed requires
